name: task_retry
description: Retry a terminal blocked, failed, timed-out, or cancelled `task_spawn` subagent as a new linked attempt using the original task configuration. Resolve any reported authorization, permission, or user-input requirement before retrying. Returns a new task_id; collect and integrate the old and new attempts separately.

task_id.description: Terminal blocked, failed, timed-out, or cancelled task_id to retry with the original configuration. Its terminal result must already have been collected with `task_wait` or `task_status`; retrying before collection is rejected.
